scope: Provider-free inspection of retained DEV014 compact lifecycle journals and DEV020 comparable cohort facts.
reason: Retained compact journals contain observed extrema, timestamps, aggregate coverage, request metadata, and peak_to_subsequent_trough summaries. They do not retain chronological post-peak 1-minute OHLCV open/close values, raw payloads, or a non-padded candle path.
prohibited_substitutions: aggregate post-peak trough is not a single candle close
ATH-to-trough drawdown is not open-to-close candle loss
latest observed MC is not a crash candle close
missing_evidence: ordered non-padded post-peak candles at one fixed interval
bounded evidence provenance sufficient to reject padded/synthetic observations
minimum_additional_acquisition: Separately authorize at most one bounded 1-minute MC OHLCV range per eligible token from retained observed-peak timestamp to retained lifecycle-window end, with compact normalization retaining only the first qualifying >=85% open-to-close candle (or explicit none), no raw payload, fixed byte cap, shared provider budget, and no retries/pagination. This is not authorized by DEV026.
storage: One compact JSON feasibility artifact; no provider call, raw retention, journal mutation, or 500 MB growth path.
